title: A worker runs its declared check with the check's Compose services on its own head
description: A fixture repository's preMerge check verify declares a postgres db Compose service. The worker that holds the item's lease runs 'graphyard check verify' in its confined worktree: the host loop runs that check on the worker's HEAD as the merge trial runs it (stub docker first on PATH, a loopback listener for db), and the worker gets the check's output and whether it passed or failed. A worker without the lease is refused, and the worker sandbox reaches no Docker socket.

steps.name: a leased worker runs its declared check on its head through the host; another worker is refused
